To solve this problem, I need to determine the effect of strong non-oxidizing acids on cyanide compounds. Specifically, the options are:

A. Absorb cyanide  
B. Form a salt  
C. Release gaseous hydrogen cyanide  
D. Release oxygen  

I will consider the chemical reaction between strong non-oxidizing acids and cyanide compounds. Typically, strong acids can protonate the cyanide ion (CN⁻), potentially releasing hydrogen cyanide gas (HCN).

The reaction is as follows:

\[ \text{H}^+ + \text{CN}^- \rightarrow \text{HCN(g)} \]

This suggests that option C, "Release gaseous hydrogen cyanide," is correct.
